description.narrative:
MAKI+Fiesta is a civic and creative initiative jointly organized by independent Filipino media organizations (Probe Productions, FYT Media, and PumaPodcast, in partnership with the University of the Philippines, the Quezon City Government, and with support from International Media Support). This is the 2nd iteration of the festival, following the success of last year.
The festival serves as a platform for journalists, artists, technologists, designers, content creators, and innovators to explore how democracy and freedom of expression underpin creative economies and inclusive societies. It particularly targets young people who are navigating an era of shrinking civic spaces, rising disinformation, and social fatigue toward traditional activism.
The upcoming 2025 edition is envisioned as a two-day gathering on December 11 and 12 at UP Diliman, utilizing multiple theaters, galleries, and outdoor venues for plenaries, breakout sessions, workshops, and artistic performances. The program will feature discussions on media and truth-telling, technology and digital rights, creative industry collaborations, and other cross-sectoral civic themes. In addition, there will be a community marketplace showcasing grassroots organizations, student groups, and independent creators, as well as evening concerts, open mic sessions, and networking activities to encourage interaction among participants. MAKI+Fiesta remains free and open to the public, with registration required. Organizers are also raising funds to support the participation of 20 to 25 speakers and delegates from outside Metro Manila and across Southeast Asia to reinforce its regional scope.
